Council Meetings

Council Meetings

The Shire of Williams Ordinary Council Meetings are held on the third Wednesday of each month at 4:00pm, excluding January. These meetings are held in the Council Chambers at the Shire Administration Office, 9 Brooking Street, Williams.

  • Public Question Time
  • Past Council Meetings 

Public Question Time

Members of the public are welcome to attend meetings. Public questions can be made at the commencement of the meetings.

To expedite question time, you are requested to put your question in writing and hand it, or a copy of it, to the Chief Executive Officer prior to the meeting commencing. Alternatively, this form can be emailed to ceo@williams.wa.qov.au prior to the meeting commencing (no later than 12pm on the day prior to the Ordinary Council Meeting).

How question time works:

1. The Presiding Member will declare the meeting open, then may ask for any questions from the public. You then acknowledge you have a question.

2. The Presiding Member will call on the public to ask their questions.

3. State your full name and address.

4. Ask the question, directed to the Presiding Member.

5. A question may be taken on notice by the Council for a later response.

6. When a question is taken on notice, the response will be sent directly to the member of the public asking the question in writing and will be included in the agenda at the next meeting of the Council or Committee as the case requires.
